WITH wd AS (SELECT date FROM workdays WHERE is_workday = 1 AND date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM wd), emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2024-01-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2024-12-31')), absent AS (SELECT a.emp_no, COUNT(DISTINCT wd.date) AS d FROM absences a JOIN wd ON wd.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date WHERE a.emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM emp) GROUP BY a.emp_no), rate AS (SELECT e.emp_no, (SELECT n FROM total) - COALESCE(ab.d, 0) AS att, (SELECT n FROM total) AS tot FROM emp e LEFT JOIN absent ab ON ab.emp_no = e.emp_no) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt_emp, SUM(CAST(att AS REAL) / tot < 0.8) AS below_80 FROM rate;

WITH bal AS (SELECT e.emp_no, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(days),0) FROM leave_grants g WHERE g.emp_no=e.emp_no AND g.grant_date<='2025-12-31') - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END),0) FROM leave_usages u WHERE u.emp_no=e.emp_no AND u.use_date<='2025-12-31') AS remain FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date<='2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>'2025-12-31')), sal AS (SELECT emp_no, amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE effective_from=(SELECT MAX(effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no=s.emp_no AND s2.effective_from<='2025-12-31')) SELECT ROUND(SUM(remain*sal.amount_k*1000.0/209*8)) FROM bal JOIN sal USING(emp_no);

WITH wd AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM workdays WHERE date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND is_workday=1), emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE hire_date < '2024-01-01' AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= '2024-12-31')), ab AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.emp_no, w.date FROM absences a JOIN workdays w ON w.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date AND w.date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND w.is_workday=1 WHERE a.reason_cd IN ('10','20') AND a.emp_no IN (SELECT emp_no FROM emp)), rate AS (SELECT e.emp_no, 1.0 - COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ab WHERE ab.emp_no=e.emp_no),0)*1.0/(SELECT n FROM wd) AS r FROM emp e) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, (SELECT n FROM wd) AS workdays, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM emp) AS emp_total FROM rate WHERE r < 0.8

WITH emp AS (SELECT emp_no FROM employees WHERE status IN ('A','L') AND hire_date <= '2025-12-31'), sal AS (SELECT s.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM salaries s WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(effective_from) FROM salaries t WHERE t.emp_no = s.emp_no AND t.effective_from <= '2025-12-31')), g AS (SELECT emp_no, SUM(days) AS granted FROM leave_grants WHERE grant_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no), u AS (SELECT emp_no, SUM(CASE unit_cd WHEN 'D' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'H' THEN 0.5 WHEN 'Q' THEN 0.25 END) AS used FROM leave_usages WHERE use_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY emp_no), x AS (SELECT e.emp_no, COALESCE(g.granted,0) - COALESCE(u.used,0) AS unused, CAST(sal.amount_k * 1000 / 12.0 / 209 * 8 AS INTEGER) AS daily FROM emp e LEFT JOIN g ON g.emp_no=e.emp_no LEFT JOIN u ON u.emp_no=e.emp_no LEFT JOIN sal ON sal.emp_no=e.emp_no) SELECT CAST(SUM(unused*daily) AS INTEGER) FROM x

WITH RECURSIVE sub(dept_cd) AS (SELECT 'D08' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_cd FROM departments d JOIN sub s ON d.parent_cd = s.dept_cd) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no), COUNT(*) FROM employees e JOIN emp_depts ed USING(emp_no) WHERE ed.is_primary = 1 AND ed.dept_cd IN (SELECT dept_cd FROM sub) AND ed.from_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (ed.to_date IS NULL OR ed.to_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.hire_date <= '2025-12-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-12-31') AND e.status IN ('A','L');

WITH target AS (SELECT e.emp_no, e.grade_cd, ev.rating, CASE ev.rating WHEN 'S' THEN 20 WHEN 'A' THEN 10 WHEN 'B' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END AS pct FROM employees e JOIN evaluations ev ON ev.emp_no = e.emp_no AND ev.year = 2024 WHERE e.grade_cd <> 'E' AND e.hire_date <= '2025-03-31' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2025-03-31')), sal AS (SELECT t.emp_no, s.amount_k FROM target t JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no = t.emp_no WHERE s.effective_from = (SELECT MAX(s2.effective_from) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.emp_no = t.emp_no AND s2.effective_from <= '2024-12-31')) SELECT SUM(amount_k*1000*pct/100) AS total FROM (SELECT t.emp_no, t.pct, s.amount_k FROM target t JOIN sal s ON s.emp_no = t.emp_no WHERE t.pct > 0);

WITH base AS (SELECT e.emp_no, e.grade_cd FROM employees e WHERE e.hire_date < '2024-01-01' AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date >= '2024-12-31')), wd AS (SELECT date FROM workdays WHERE is_workday=1 AND date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'), absd AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.emp_no, w.date FROM absences a JOIN wd w ON w.date BETWEEN a.from_date AND a.to_date WHERE a.reason_cd IN ('10','20') AND a.from_date <= '2024-12-31' AND a.to_date >= '2024-01-01'), rates AS (SELECT b.emp_no, b.grade_cd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wd) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM absd x WHERE x.emp_no=b.emp_no) AS absent FROM base b) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (total-absent)*1.0/total < 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_cnt FROM rates;
